description: Graph the quadratic function f(x) = x² - 4x + 3 in GeoGebra. Use the input bar to enter the function (type: x^2 - 4x + 3). After graphing, analyze the parabola mathematically and mark at least 3 of the 4 key points: (1) the vertex (use x = -b/2a to find the x-coordinate, then evaluate f(x) for the y-coordinate), (2) the x-intercepts (solve f(x) = 0 by factoring or using the quadratic formula), and (3) the y-intercept (evaluate f(0)). Create Point objects at each location using the Point tool or by typing coordinates in the input bar. Marking key points is REQUIRED for the task to pass. Save the construction as 'quadratic_graph.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/
